api_types.name: EvalHubMCPSpec
api_types.doc: EvalHubMCPSpec defines the optional MCP server deployment configuration.

fields.name: Enabled
fields.doc: Enabled controls whether the MCP server is deployed. Defaults to false.

fields.name: Replicas
fields.doc: Replicas is the number of MCP server replicas. Defaults to 1.

fields.name: Transport
fields.doc: Transport is the MCP client transport mode exposed by the MCP server: "http" (default) or "http-sse".

fields.name: EvalHubTransport
fields.doc: EvalHubTransport overrides EVALHUB_TRANSPORT when set (MCP server transport: "http" or "http-sse"). When omitted, the value of transport is used for both --transport and EVALHUB_TRANSPORT.

fields.name: Env
fields.doc: Env provides additional/override environment variables for the MCP server container.

fields.name: Resources
fields.doc: Resources defines container resource requests/limits for the MCP server.

fields.name: Image
fields.doc: Image overrides the default MCP server container image.

fields.name: AuthSecret
fields.doc: AuthSecret is the name of a Secret containing a "token" key used by evalhub-mcp to call the EvalHub API (fronted by kube-rbac-proxy). External MCP clients reach the MCP Service through a separate kube-rbac-proxy sidecar and must have RBAC get/create on evalhubs/proxy for this instance.

api_types.name: EvalHubMCPStatus
api_types.doc: EvalHubMCPStatus contains status information for the optional MCP server.

fields.name: Phase
fields.doc: Phase is the current lifecycle phase of the MCP server.

fields.name: Ready
fields.doc: Ready indicates whether the MCP server deployment is available.

fields.name: URL
fields.doc: URL is the externally accessible endpoint (Route or Service URL).

fields.name: Conditions
fields.doc: Conditions contains detailed status conditions for the MCP server.

fields.name: Replicas
fields.doc: Number of replicas for the eval-hub deployment

fields.name: Env
fields.doc: Environment variables for the eval-hub container

fields.name: Providers
fields.doc: Providers is the list of OOTB provider names to mount into the deployment. Each name must match a provider-name label on a ConfigMap in the operator namespace.

fields.name: Collections
fields.doc: Collections is the list of OOTB collection names to mount into the deployment. Each name must match a collection-name label on a ConfigMap in the operator namespace.

fields.name: Database
fields.doc: Database configuration for persistent storage. This field is required: the operator will not start the service without an explicit database configuration. Set type to "postgresql" with a secret reference, or "sqlite" for lightweight/development deployments.

fields.name: Otel
fields.doc: OpenTelemetry configuration for observability. When set, the operator includes OTEL settings in the generated config. When omitted, the service uses its defaults (OTEL disabled).

fields.name: MCP
fields.doc: MCP optionally enables an MCP server deployment connected to this EvalHub instance.

fields.name: Tenancy
fields.doc: Tenancy controls the deployment mode of this EvalHub instance. "multi" (default): serves multiple tenant namespaces labelled with evalhub.trustyai.opendatahub.io/tenant. "single": serves only its own namespace; no cross-namespace resource propagation.

fields.doc: Name of the K8s Secret containing a pre-composed db-url key. Required when type is "postgresql"; ignored for "sqlite".

api_types.name: OTELSpec
api_types.doc: OTELSpec defines OpenTelemetry configuration for EvalHub. Its presence in the CR spec implies OTEL is enabled.

fields.name: SamplingRatio
fields.doc: Trace sampling ratio as a string-encoded float between "0" and "1" (e.g. "0.5"). Defaults to "1.0" (sample everything) when omitted.

fields.name: TracerTimeout
fields.doc: TracerTimeout is the trace export timeout (Go duration string, e.g. "30s").

fields.name: TracerBatchInterval
fields.doc: TracerBatchInterval is the trace batch flush interval (Go duration string, e.g. "5s").

fields.name: EnableJobContainerLogs
fields.doc: EnableJobContainerLogs exports adapter container logs at job terminal transition. Requires enableLogs.

fields.name: ServiceName
fields.doc: ServiceName overrides the default OTEL service.name resource attribute.

fields.name: EnableEcsResourceDetection
fields.doc: EnableEcsResourceDetection enables ECS resource detection on the OTEL resource.

fields.name: DisableRedirectOtelLogs
fields.doc: DisableRedirectOtelLogs prevents OTEL SDK diagnostic logs from being redirected to the main logger.

fields.name: DisableDatabaseOtelScans
fields.doc: DisableDatabaseOtelScans disables database query spans while still allowing DB metrics when enabled.

fields.name: MetricExportInterval
fields.doc: MetricExportInterval is the metrics export interval (Go duration string, e.g. "60s").

fields.doc:
/* Label key to use when automatically identifying guardrail detector inference services.
	If provided, all inference services with the label `$detectorServiceLabelToMatch: true` will be used as a guardrails detector.

operator_config.name: discoveryConfigMapName
operator_config.doc:
Discovery ConfigMap injected into every tenant namespace for EvalHub service URL resolution.
A single well-known CM is shared across all EvalHub instances; each instance owns one
key of the form "{instanceName}.url" so multiple EvalHub instances can coexist.

operator_config.name: evalHubAppPort
operator_config.doc:
evalHubAppPort is the eval-hub container listen port on loopback (API_HOST=127.0.0.1, PORT in deployment env).
kube-rbac-proxy upstream is http://127.0.0.1:<evalHubAppPort>/ on the pod network (TLS is terminated on servicePort).

operator_config.name: evalHubHealthPath
operator_config.doc: evalHubHealthPath is the application health check path exposed via the Route (SAR-protected by kube-rbac-proxy).

operator_config.name: evalHubInternalHealthPath
operator_config.doc:
evalHubInternalHealthPath is the cluster-internal health check path served by the main API server on evalHubAppPort.
Kubelet probes reach it via kube-rbac-proxy (servicePort), which bypasses SAR for this path (--ignore-paths).

operator_config.name: invalidPlacementReason
operator_config.doc: Tenancy

operator_config.name: kubeRBACProxyContainerName
operator_config.doc: kube-rbac-proxy sidecar

operator_config.name: kubeRBACProxyHealthPath
operator_config.doc: kubeRBACProxyHealthPath is served by kube-rbac-proxy on kubeRBACProxyHealthPort (see --proxy-endpoints-port).

operator_config.name: mcpAppPort
operator_config.doc: mcpAppPort is the evalhub-mcp listen port on loopback; kube-rbac-proxy terminates TLS on mcpServicePort.

operator_config.name: mcpBinaryPath
operator_config.doc: MCP server configuration

operator_config.name: metricsPort
operator_config.doc:
metricsPort is the dedicated Prometheus metrics port on the EvalHub container.
Bound to 0.0.0.0, serves /metrics over plain HTTP with no auth (cluster-internal only).
Port 8081 is used (not 9090) because the redhat-ods-applications namespace NetworkPolicy
allowlists 8081 but not 9090, avoiding the need for a component-level NetworkPolicy.

operator_config.name: providersTenantVolumeName
operator_config.doc:
Tenant provider/collection ConfigMap volume and mount path configuration.
Tenant CMs are mounted at a separate /tenant/ sub-path so they cannot shadow system configs.

operator_config.doc: Default pod security context

operator_config.doc: Service CA configuration

operator_config.value: errors.New("missing or incomplete evalhub instance labels on Job")
operator_config.doc:
ErrMissingEvalHubLabels is returned by evalHubBaseURLFromJob when required evalhub_instance_* labels
on the Job are absent or only one of the pair is set (malformed / incomplete).

operator_config.name: annotationKueueFailedWorkloadEventReported
operator_config.doc:
After a successful POST to EvalHub, the Workload is annotated so we do not report the same
failure on every reconcile.

operator_config.name: evalHubEvaluationFailedKueueWorkloadsControllerName
operator_config.doc: evalHubEvaluationFailedKueueWorkloadsControllerName matches ctrl.NewControllerManagedBy(mgr).Named(...).

operator_config.name: gpuResourceSuffixes
operator_config.doc:
gpuResourceSuffixes are the trailing parts of Kubernetes extended resource names that identify
GPU accelerators (e.g. "nvidia.com/gpu", "amd.com/gpu"). We match by suffix to avoid hard-coding
vendor-specific resource names and to remain forward-compatible.

operator_config.name: kueueWorkloadReasonInadmissible
operator_config.doc: kueueWorkloadReasonInadmissible matches Kueue's Workload condition Reason when quota cannot be reserved.

operator_config.name: messageCodeGPUUnavailable
operator_config.doc:
messageCodeGPUUnavailable is sent to EvalHub when Kueue cannot admit a workload because GPU
resources required by the adapter are not available in the requested queue.

operator_config.name: annotationFailurePending
operator_config.doc: annotationFailurePending: in-flight until POST succeeds and we set annotationFailureReported.

operator_config.name: evalHubEvaluationJobFailureControllerName
operator_config.doc: evalHubEvaluationJobFailureControllerName matches ctrl.NewControllerManagedBy(mgr).Named(...) for logs and registration.

operator_config.name: evalHubExtraCABundleEnv
operator_config.doc: evalHubExtraCABundleEnv, if set, is a filesystem path to additional PEM CA certs (optional).

operator_config.name: evalHubInstanceNameLabel
operator_config.doc: EvalHub CR identity for evalHubBaseURLFromJob (set by eval-hub job_builders; must match eval-hub).

operator_config.name: messageCodeQueueError
operator_config.doc:
messageCodeQueueError is used when reporting EvalHub benchmark failure from a Kueue Workload
with QuotaReserved=False and Reason=Inadmissible (see evaluation_failed_kueue_workloads_reconciler.go).

operator_config.name: openshiftServiceCAMountPath
operator_config.doc:
openshiftServiceCAMountPath: PEM for the OpenShift service signing CA (trust in-cluster *.svc HTTPS, e.g. EvalHub).
Appended to the HTTP client root CAs; the in-cluster SA transport defaults to apiserver trust only.

operator_config.name: schedulingGracePeriod
operator_config.doc:
schedulingGracePeriod is how long a pod may remain Unschedulable before the operator treats it as
a terminal failure. This allows transient conditions (e.g. autoscaler node provisioning) to resolve
before EvalHub is notified. Permanent conditions (e.g. missing PVC) still fire after the period.

operator_config.name: authReviewerClusterRoleName
operator_config.doc:
authReviewerClusterRoleName is the ClusterRole for EvalHub SAR auth checks only.
It contains only tokenreviews/create and subjectaccessreviews/create permissions.

operator_config.name: mlflowAccessClusterRoleName
operator_config.doc:
MLFlow access uses custom ClusterRoles scoped to the "mlflow.kubeflow.org" API group.
MLFlow's kubernetes-workspace-provider checks permissions via SelfSubjectAccessReview
against this group (not core Kubernetes resources). The ClusterRoles are pre-created
at operator installation time (config/rbac/evalhub_mlflow_access_role.yaml and
config/rbac/evalhub_mlflow_jobs_role.yaml).

operator_config.name: mlflowJobsAccessClusterRoleName
operator_config.doc:
mlflowJobsAccessClusterRoleName is a restricted MLflow ClusterRole for job pods.
Jobs only need create, get, list -- not update or delete.

operator_config.name: modelSecretClusterRoleName
operator_config.doc:
modelSecretClusterRoleName is the ClusterRole that grants the eval-hub service SA
get/create/delete on Secrets in tenant namespaces, enabling internalModelRef secret (ref-token) lifecycle.

operator_config.name: tenantLabel
operator_config.doc:
tenantLabel is the label that marks a namespace as an EvalHub tenant namespace.
When the operator detects a namespace with this label, it automatically provisions
the job ServiceAccount and RBAC bindings required for evaluation jobs to run there.

operator_config.name: CABundleMountPath
operator_config.doc:
CABundleMountPath is the file path at which the merged CA bundle is mounted inside the lm-eval pod.
REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE is set to this path so Python's requests library picks it up automatically.

operator_config.name: CABundleVolumeName
operator_config.doc: CABundleVolumeName is the volume name used when auto-mounting the merged CA bundle.

operator_config.name: DefaultCABundleConfigMapName
operator_config.doc:
DefaultCABundleConfigMapName is the standard RHOAI ConfigMap that holds the cluster CA bundle.
It is injected into managed namespaces by the RHOAI operator.

operator_config.name: LastScheduledGenerationAnnotation
operator_config.doc:
LastScheduledGenerationAnnotation records the spec generation that was active when the pod
was last created. When a completed job's current generation exceeds this value the operator
knows the spec changed and resets the job so it can be re-run with the updated configuration.

operator_config.name: MergedCABundleKey
operator_config.doc: MergedCABundleKey is the key used in the per-job merged CA ConfigMap.

operator_config.name: MergedCAConfigMapSuffix
operator_config.doc: MergedCAConfigMapSuffix is appended to the job name to form the merged CA ConfigMap name.

operator_config.name: ServiceCAConfigMapName
operator_config.doc:
ServiceCAConfigMapName is the well-known ConfigMap that contains the OpenShift
service-serving CA, used by cluster-internal HTTPS services (*.svc.cluster.local).

operator_config.name: ServiceCAKey
operator_config.doc: ServiceCAKey is the standard key within the service-serving CA ConfigMap.

operator_config.name: DefaultPort
operator_config.doc: the default port for the driver to listen on

operator_config.name: progressMsgPattern
operator_config.doc: from https://gist.github.com/andenacitelli/20a98f8c45499fe21d55266b776d3071 -> regex pattern to extract tqdm fields

AllowedModels

operator_config.name: PatternArgName
operator_config.doc: PatternArgName allows for alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, and dots in argument names

operator_config.name: PatternArgValue
operator_config.doc: PatternArgValue allows for reasonable characters (including spaces) in arg values

operator_config.name: PatternLimit
operator_config.doc: PatternLimit allows for integers, floats, and percentage in limit values

operator_config.name: PatternModelName
operator_config.doc: PatternModelName allows for alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, forward slashes, dots, and colons in model names

operator_config.name: PatternTaskName
operator_config.doc: PatternTaskName allows for alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, parentheses in task names

operator_config.name: PatternTemplateName
operator_config.doc: PatternTemplateName allows for alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores, dots, and colons in template names

operator_config.name: DefaultRequeueInterval
operator_config.doc: DefaultRequeueInterval is the interval for periodic health checks

operator_config.name: FinalizerName
operator_config.doc: FinalizerName is the finalizer added to TrustyAI module resources

operator_config.name: ServiceName
operator_config.doc: ServiceName is the name used for service registration

operator_config.name: maxConfigMapKeyLength
operator_config.doc:
maxConfigMapKeyLength defines the maximum allowed length for ConfigMap keys
based on Kubernetes DNS subdomain name limits.

operator_config.name: validConfigMapKeyRegex
operator_config.doc:
validConfigMapKeyRegex defines allowed characters for ConfigMap keys.
Kubernetes ConfigMap keys must be valid DNS subdomain names or data keys.

operator_config.name: serviceAccountNamespaceFile
operator_config.doc: Default service account namespace file path (overridable for testing)

summary: trustyai-service-operator is a Kubernetes component. managing 4 CRD(s): TrustyAI, EvalHub, LMEvalJob, TrustyAIService. deploying 1 workload(s) (trustyai-service-operator-controller-manager) with 1 container(s). watching 15 resource type(s). exposing 3 service(s) on ports: 443, 8080, 8443. defining 25 API spec type(s) across 84 struct(s) with 364 total fields. with 430 operator config constants (36 image references, 7 env vars). following 54 reconciliation steps across 6 controller(s). reporting 14 status condition types. integrates with Istio, Kueue, management relationship via labels/annotations. deploys kube-rbac-proxy sidecar for RBAC-based authorization. kustomize overlays: config/base, config/components/evalhub, config/components/gorch, config/components/job-mgr, config/components/lmes, config/components/module, config/components/nemo-guardrails, config/components/tas, config/components/webhook, config/configmaps/evalhub, config/configmaps, config/crd, config/manager, config/manifests, config/overlays/evalhub-only, config/overlays/lmes, config/overlays/mcp-guardrails, config/overlays/odh, config/overlays/odh-kueue, config/overlays/rhoai, config/overlays/testing, config/prometheus, config/rbac-base, config/scorecard. references components: eval-hub (import, provider), kserve (import), kube-rbac-proxy (config).
